finding: Bibliography guards store literal entry text under original_entry/proposed_entry, their literal-text hashes, and separate before_full_entry_path/after_full_entry_path values. Full entry files add exactly one newline after the literal text. Two preparation assertions exposed the interface mismatch before canonical mutation.
exact_adapter: The parser first verifies the literal old/new SHA values and verifies file text equals old plus one newline and new plus one newline, respectively. It then binds full file hashes for the complete-block comparison. No whitespace is normalized.
